## Tutorial improvements

- Resize the in-engine tutorial to use more of your window while preserving each lesson's stage proportions.
- Open the active lesson scene directly in the Godot editor from its scene-path button. The link follows your C# or GDScript selection and animates when an editor connection is available.
- Include the tutorial's editor plugin in the standalone download so scene links work immediately when running the project from Godot.
- Fix tutorial controls initializing before their references are restored during editor assembly reloads.
- Match the convenient syntax-sugar examples to the structured examples by repeating their ping-pong pulse twice in both C# and GDScript, in the tutorial and web documentation.

## Documentation

- Make the web tutorial, standalone tutorial download, and lesson sources easier to find in the README.
- Explain how to open lesson scenes from the standalone tutorial.

## Downloads

- **Godot addon:** `tweens.gd-0.1.7-beta.zip` includes C# and GDScript sources, stable UIDs, and prebuilt native libraries. Requires Godot 4.7 or later (tested with 4.7.2); C# additionally requires Godot .NET and .NET 8 or later. GDScript-only projects do not require .NET.
- **Standalone tutorial:** `tweens.gd-tutorial.zip` includes the complete tutorial project and the 0.1.7-beta addon. Requires Godot .NET 4.7.2 and the .NET 8 SDK or later.
- **Compiled C# package:** `tweens.gd.0.1.7-beta.nupkg`, targeting .NET 8 and .NET 10, with symbols in `tweens.gd.0.1.7-beta.snupkg`.

**Full changelog:** [v0.1.6-beta…v0.1.7-beta](https://github.com/outfox/tweens.gd/compare/v0.1.6-beta...v0.1.7-beta)
